environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) running behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at instance). Instance security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering layer. Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database contains production user records including password hashes and PII in additional columns beyond what the SELECT exposes.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener, no HTTP-level inspection
config.database: SQLite 3.39 with FTS5 extension enabled, multi-statement execution allowed
